title: Will He Round the Point?
source: Statens Museum for Kunst, Copenhagen (public domain). Wikimedia Commons: Michael Ancher - Vil han klare pynten - 1885.png
caption: They can only watch. Will he make it back? #arthistory #ocean #painting #sea #art
_verify: Models were real Skagen fishermen, several of them lifeboat men (SMK) — check.
The boat itself is not visible in the painting; the slides say so only through the men's gaze.

slides.headline: They can only watch. Will he make it *back*?
slides.sub: Michael Ancher, Will He Round the Point?, 1885

slides.headline: A storm on the coast of Skagen. Fishermen gather on the *beach*.
One man points out to sea. There is a *boat* out there.
His neighbour squints into the wind, *silent*.
An old fisherman sits, hands clasped, as if *praying*.
A younger man leans in to see *better*.
Behind them, more fishermen push in to *watch*.
Out there, the waves crash toward the *point*.
Their boots stand in wet sand and *seaweed*.
Ancher painted real Skagen fishermen, many of them *rescuers*.
They can only watch. Will he make it *round*?
